templates.title: Case Chronology

templates.title: Case Status Update

templates.title: Client Advice About Requested Medical Examination

templates.title: Client Consent to a Specific Testimonial or Case Description

templates.title: Client File Retention and Disposition Instructions

templates.title: Conflict Disclosure and Consent

templates.title: File Closing Letter

templates.title: Final Limitations Warning to Client

templates.title: Limitations Deadline Warning to Client

templates.title: Nonengagement Letter
templates.scope: Prospective adult client where representation has not begun; not withdrawal from an existing case.

templates.title: Personal Injury Contingent Fee Agreement
templates.scope: Ordinary adult Virginia PI contingent representation; no minors, class action, government-fee cap or outside-counsel split assumed.

templates.title: Personal Injury Intake Questionnaire
templates.scope: Prospective Virginia adult PI client; intake and conflict/deadline triage, not a fee agreement.

templates.title: Representation Confirmation to Client
templates.scope: Client-facing confirmation after an actual Virginia PI engagement; not notice to an insurer.

templates.title: Authorized Prior Claims History Request

templates.title: Client Evidence and Social Media Preservation Advisory

templates.title: DMV Driver and Vehicle Records Request
templates.scope: Cover request accompanying current DMV requirements; not a replacement for CRD-93 or authorization.

templates.title: Employee Safety and Exposure Records Request
templates.scope: Authorized employee request to an employer for covered OSHA/VOSH records; separate voluntary requests from regulatory access rights.

templates.title: Employment and Wage Verification
templates.scope: Voluntary employer verification for wage-loss investigation; separate from the statutory retained-records request.

templates.title: Evidence Preservation Follow-Up and Spoliation Warning
templates.scope: Targeted follow-up to a documented preservation concern; no assumed finding of misconduct.

templates.title: Preservation of Evidence
templates.scope: Virginia personal-injury matter; ordinary adult claimant.

templates.title: Request for Employment and Wage Records
templates.scope: Statutory request by a current/former employee’s attorney for the specific retained employment records covered by § 8.01-413.1.

templates.title: Request for Virginia Crash Report
templates.scope: Written request for a DMV-maintained Virginia crash report by an eligible person’s attorney; official application requirements still apply.

templates.title: Social Media Preservation Demand

templates.title: Traffic Signal Records Request

templates.title: Vehicle Event Data Preservation and Access Request

templates.title: Video Preservation and Copy Request

templates.title: Voluntary Request for Incident Records

templates.title: Workplace Safety Public Records Request

templates.title: Request for Policy and Coverage Documents

templates.scope: Competent adult client’s specific settlement instruction; not a release to the opposing party or court approval for a protected claimant.

templates.title: Client Trust Ledger and Settlement Accounting
templates.scope: A client-specific record and reconciliation template; not a substitute for required account-wide journals and bank reconciliation.

templates.scope: Negotiated private Virginia civil disclosure agreement; not a court protective order, employment NDA or public-agency secrecy promise.

templates.scope: Limited Settlement Indemnity Agreement for a Virginia personal injury matter; verify actual recipient, authority and case posture.

templates.scope: Circuit Court appointment motion only. The original catalog combined appointment and report; an actual GAL must investigate and author the report. Do not generate findings, consent, a completed appointment or unsupported mandatory appointment.

templates.title: Personal Injury Settlement Agreement
templates.scope: Negotiated adult private PI settlement; not a complete minor, wrongful-death, structured-settlement or statutory UIM package.

templates.title: Proposed Order for Protected Deposit of Minor Settlement
templates.scope: Circuit Court only; use solely the qualified-fiduciary route after approval of the compromise. A bank account by itself is not a statutory substitute for qualification, bond inquiry or the approval order. Institution acceptance and restrictions require case review; this is not a universally mandated Virginia blocked-account form.

templates.title: Proposed Order of Dismissal After Settlement
templates.scope: Dismissal order implementing an actual settlement disposition in Circuit Court; not a unilateral notice of dismissal or a nonsuit motion.

templates.title: Release of Identified Personal Injury Claims
templates.scope: Adult claimant’s defined release in an ordinary private PI settlement; no automatic universal release of all persons or all unrelated claims.

templates.title: Settlement Allocation Addendum
templates.scope: Use only supported, genuinely agreed allocations. Do not invent a tax-advantaged split, a tax indemnity or a representation that the IRS accepts the allocation. Court approval and tax counsel review depend on the actual case.

templates.title: Settlement Disbursement Statement
templates.scope: Matter-specific contingent-fee closing accounting; not an actual payment instruction or substitute for trust-ledger reconciliation.

templates.title: Settlement Information for Virginia Tax Review
templates.scope: Limited to an authorized factual transmittal to a tax adviser. It is not a Virginia agency notification, return, allocation opinion or universal tax clearance.

templates.title: Structured Settlement Payment Addendum
templates.scope: This is an original payment addendum, not an issuer’s annuity confirmation or assignment form. Obtain actual provider documents and individualized tax and benefits advice. Never describe a quoted product as issued or funded.

templates.title: Affidavit and Return of Service
templates.scope: Virginia private process-server factual affidavit; sheriff and statutory special-service forms require adaptation.

templates.title: Affidavit of Non-Service
templates.scope: Virginia private process-server factual affidavit; sheriff and statutory special-service forms require adaptation.

templates.title: Affirmative Defenses
templates.scope: Identified defense module accompanying a proper Virginia responsive pleading.

templates.title: Answer to Complaint
templates.scope: Paragraph-by-paragraph answer to the actual Virginia Circuit Court complaint; not a general denial.

templates.title: Attorney Issued Subpoena Transmittal to Clerk

templates.title: Certificate of Service of Subsequent Papers
templates.scope: Virginia circuit court certificate under Rule 1:12 for papers after initial process; append to the served paper. Not an initial-process return or appellate certificate.

No special statutory claim, minor, estate, government defendant, medical malpractice, or additional liability count.

templates.title: Counterclaim
templates.scope: Cause of action asserted by a defendant against a plaintiff under Virginia Rule 3:9.

templates.title: Cross-Claim
templates.scope: Defendant claim against a co-defendant arising from a matter pleaded in the complaint.

templates.title: Demand for Jury Trial
templates.scope: Written Virginia Circuit Court jury demand on issues triable of right; no imported jury-fee-posting procedure.

templates.title: Demurrer
templates.scope: Specific challenge to legal sufficiency of an identified Virginia Circuit Court pleading; not a generic federal plausibility motion.

templates.title: Demurrer to Amended Complaint
templates.scope: Specific legal-sufficiency challenge to the current amended complaint.

templates.title: Grounds of Defense
templates.scope: Grounds of Defense for a Virginia personal injury matter; verify actual recipient, authority and case posture.

templates.title: Notice of Related Proceeding
templates.scope: Notice of Related Proceeding for a Virginia personal injury matter; verify actual recipient, authority and case posture.

templates.title: Third-Party Complaint
templates.scope: Derivative claim against a nonparty who may owe all or part of the defending party’s liability.

templates.title: Application for Letter Rogatory
templates.scope: Virginia application for judicial assistance to take evidence outside the Commonwealth; destination requirements separately verified.

templates.title: Business Records Subpoena Duces Tecum
templates.scope: Attorney-issued Virginia Rule 4:9A nonparty business-records discovery; excludes medical records, trial-only process and specially protected officials.

templates.title: Discovery Deficiency and Conference Request
templates.scope: Good-faith correspondence concerning Virginia Circuit Court civil discovery.

templates.title: Expert Witness Disclosure
templates.scope: Virginia Circuit Court civil personal-injury litigation.

templates.title: Interrogatories Concerning Trial Experts
templates.scope: Circuit Court civil discovery. Not an automatic federal Rule 26 exchange or California demand. Count all parts/subparts with prior interrogatories against Rule 4:8(g)’s 30 limit; normally serve without filing under 4:8(c). No unsupported demand for an expert report, protected draft or consultant.

templates.title: Motion for Discovery Sanctions
templates.scope: A supported Rule 4:12 discovery-sanctions request, with the applicable route expressly identified.

templates.title: Motion for Physical or Mental Examination
templates.scope: Rule 4:10 motion seeking a defined examination on good cause; not a unilateral command to attend.

templates.title: Motion for Protective Order
templates.scope: Virginia Circuit Court civil personal-injury litigation.

templates.title: Motion to Compel Discovery
templates.scope: Virginia Circuit Court civil personal-injury litigation.

templates.title: Notice of Deposition of a Party

templates.scope: Virginia Circuit Court civil motion notice; use the locality’s required praecipe instead where applicable.

templates.title: Proposed Consent Order
templates.scope: Consent order based on actual agreement by all persons whose consent is represented.

templates.title: Proposed Final Order
templates.scope: Proposed Virginia Circuit Court final disposition; remaining claims and statutory continuing authority must be verified.

templates.title: Proposed Order
templates.scope: Proposed Virginia Circuit Court ruling on a specified issue; not an entered order.

templates.title: Reply Memorandum in Support of Motion
templates.scope: Reply on an existing Virginia Circuit Court motion when the applicable schedule or permission allows it.

templates.title: Deposition Designations and Counter-Designations
templates.scope: Precise excerpts proposed for trial under the applicable order and Rule 4:7.

templates.title: Motion in Limine
templates.scope: Narrow evidentiary motion for an actual Virginia Circuit Court trial issue; not an automatic substitute for a dispositive motion.

templates.title: Motion to Strike the Evidence
templates.scope: Virginia civil trial motion challenging evidentiary sufficiency, not a California pleading motion or federal directed verdict.

templates.title: Objections to Proposed Jury Instructions
templates.scope: Specific objections and proposed correction tied to the actual tendered instruction set.

templates.title: Offer of Proof
templates.scope: Record of specifically excluded evidence and its purpose, prepared for an actual ruling or proffer hearing.

templates.title: Pretrial Statement
templates.scope: Virginia Circuit Court pretrial statement responding to an actual scheduling direction; not an automatic California-style joint pretrial order.

templates.title: Proposed Jury Instructions
templates.scope: Counsel submission and repeatable separate instruction leaf; all substantive instruction text must be case-selected.

templates.title: Proposed Scheduling Positions
templates.scope: Proposed Scheduling Positions for a Virginia personal injury matter; verify actual recipient, authority and case posture.

templates.title: Proposed Supplemental Juror Questionnaire
templates.scope: Case-specific Virginia civil supplemental questionnaire for court approval; not the clerk’s statutory qualification form.

templates.title: Proposed Verdict Form
templates.scope: Counsel submission and separate general verdict leaf for a simple single-plaintiff single-defendant damages claim.

templates.title: Proposed Voir Dire Questions
templates.scope: Neutral proposed questions directed to juror qualification, interest and bias in the actual civil case.

templates.title: Request to Set Trial
templates.scope: Request to Set Trial for a Virginia personal injury matter; verify actual recipient, authority and case posture.

templates.title: Stipulations of Fact
templates.scope: Actually agreed facts for a defined proceeding; scope and reservations stated expressly.

templates.title: Trial Brief
templates.scope: Case-specific Virginia Circuit Court brief addressing defined trial issues.

templates.title: Trial Exhibit List
templates.scope: Specific exhibit identification for Virginia Circuit Court trial preparation; no unsupported representation of admitted evidence.

templates.title: Trial Witness List
templates.scope: Trial witness list keyed to the entered Virginia Circuit Court scheduling order.

templates.title: Brief of Appellee
templates.scope: Court of Appeals of Virginia civil appeal from a circuit court, responsive merits brief. Cross-error only when actually raised and supported. Not a Supreme Court or federal brief. Final tables and VACES PDF preparation are case-specific.

templates.title: Memorandum of Taxable Costs
templates.scope: Virginia civil costs request; recoverability assessed item by item.

templates.title: Motion Concerning Taxable Costs
templates.scope: Virginia motion to determine or correct disputed costs; identify the requested increase, disallowance or correction.

templates.title: Motion for Attorney Fees
templates.scope: Virginia civil fee application supported by an actual contractual, statutory or other recognized fee basis.

templates.title: Motion for New Trial
templates.scope: Virginia civil-jury new-trial motion with specific preserved grounds and current trial-court jurisdiction.

templates.title: Motion for Remittitur or New Trial
templates.scope: Virginia motion addressing an excessive damages verdict under § 8.01-383.1(A).

templates.title: Motion for Suspension of Execution and Approval of Security
templates.scope: Motion for Suspension of Execution and Approval of Security for a Virginia personal injury matter; verify actual recipient, authority and case posture.

templates.title: Motion to Set Aside Verdict and Enter Judgment
templates.scope: Virginia § 8.01-430 legal insufficiency motion; not federal Rule 50.

templates.title: Motion to Vacate Judgment
templates.scope: Virginia civil judgment relief under a specifically established jurisdictional route.

templates.title: Notice of Separate Appeal
templates.scope: Notice of Separate Appeal for a Virginia personal injury matter; verify actual recipient, authority and case posture.

templates.title: Opening Brief of Appellant
templates.scope: Court of Appeals of Virginia civil appeal from a circuit court, opening merits brief. Not a petition for appeal, Supreme Court brief, criminal Anders brief or federal appeal. Complete record references, final tables and VACES PDF preparation are case-specific.

templates.title: Petition for Appeal to Supreme Court of Virginia
templates.scope: Supreme Court of Virginia civil discretionary petition for appeal only. Not a U.S. Supreme Court certiorari petition, Rule 5:17A interlocutory petition, petition for rehearing or criminal Anders filing. Verify appellate jurisdiction and statutory exceptions; do not assume direct appeal from an ordinary circuit civil judgment. Add one argument section per assignment; table pages and counts must be recomputed after drafting.

templates.title: Petition for Panel Rehearing
templates.scope: Petition for Panel Rehearing for a Virginia personal injury matter; verify actual recipient, authority and case posture.

templates.title: Preliminary Assignments of Error and Appendix Designation
templates.scope: Preliminary Assignments of Error and Appendix Designation for a Virginia personal injury matter; verify actual recipient, authority and case posture.

templates.title: Proposed Money Judgment
templates.scope: Proposed Virginia civil money judgment; not an entered judgment or collection instrument.

templates.title: Reply Brief of Appellant
templates.scope: Reply Brief of Appellant for a Virginia personal injury matter; verify actual recipient, authority and case posture.

templates.title: Request Concerning Oral Argument
templates.scope: Request Concerning Oral Argument for a Virginia personal injury matter; verify actual recipient, authority and case posture.

templates.scope: Transmittal of Entered Judgment for a Virginia personal injury matter; verify actual recipient, authority and case posture.
